# build adjacency time lists
adj=collections.defaultdict(lambda: collections.defaultdict(list))

    adj[u][v].append(t); adj[v][u].append(t)

def closures(lo,hi,delta=800, restrict=None):
    res=[]
    for u,v,t in events:
        if not (lo<=t<=hi): continue
        if restrict and not (u in restrict or v in restrict): continue
        # common neighbors
        for w in set(adj[u])&set(adj[v]):
            if w==u or w==v: continue
            t1=[x for x in adj[u][w] if x<t]
            t2=[x for x in adj[v][w] if x<t]
            if t1 and t2:
                s=max(max(t1),max(t2))
                if t-s<=delta:
                    res.append((u,v,t,w,s,t-s))
    return res
